name: anysite-gtm
description: Find and qualify the B2B companies and people to sell to. A short onboarding learns your offer, ideal customer profile and buyer personas from your website; then build target account and contact lists from 70M+ companies and 856M+ professional profiles, add funding and buying signals, map who decides at an account, keep HubSpot or Pipedrive enriched, and draft outreach grounded in real, dated events.

interface.longDescription:
Anysite GTM helps B2B sales, growth and RevOps teams find and qualify the companies and people to sell to. It builds target account and contact lists from public business data, adds firmographics and buying signals, maps who decides at an account, and drafts outreach, optionally syncing results with HubSpot or Pipedrive.

Start with a short onboarding: it reads your company website, drafts your offer, ideal customer profile, buyer personas and competitors, and asks you to confirm them, so every later request uses the same context.

What you can do:
- Build company lists from a database of 70M+ companies with precise filters (industry, size, headquarters, keywords) and see them in an interactive table you can filter, sort and export.
- Find buyer personas across 856M+ professional profiles by role, seniority, function and company.
- Go through leads one company at a time and mark each Yes, No or Skip.
- Add funding, firmographics and other public data to a list by joining sources on domain or LinkedIn URL.
- Sweep target accounts for buying signals: funding rounds, leadership changes, hiring, news.
- Get a one-page brief before a meeting, a map of the buying committee at a target account, and a verdict on a single inbound lead.
- Draft cold emails and LinkedIn messages grounded in a real, dated detail about the prospect.
- Connect HubSpot or Pipedrive to enrich, score and add records with a preview before bulk writes and undo after.

Data comes from public web sources through the anysite MCP server and requires an anysite account. Limitations: it drafts messages but never sends them, it does not guess email addresses, and CRM writes happen only after the CRM is connected and the change is confirmed.
defaultPrompt: Set up my GTM profile from our website and suggest a first prospecting run.
Find 50 B2B SaaS companies in Germany with 50-500 employees and show them in a table.
Find heads of sales at fintech companies in London and draft a first email for one.

positive.description: Onboarding drafts a GTM profile from the company website
positive.prompt: Set up my GTM profile. Our website is anysite.io.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the website through the web parser, then presents a drafted profile (what the company sells, ideal customer profile, buyer personas, competitors) for the user to confirm, asking the remaining questions one step at a time. Values not confirmed by the user are marked as inferred from the website.

positive.description: Company list from an ICP, shown as a table
positive.prompt: Find 20 B2B SaaS companies headquartered in Germany with 50-500 employees.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns companies headquartered in Germany with 50-500 employees in software/SaaS, shown in an interactive table with name, industry, employee count, headquarters, website and LinkedIn page. States how many were found.

positive.description: Lead review one company at a time
positive.prompt: Let me go through these companies one by one and mark which ones fit.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens company cards with name, tagline, description, locations, size and links, answered Yes, No or Skip. Decisions are saved and a summary of approved, rejected and skipped companies is given.

positive.description: Funding enrichment joined onto the list
positive.prompt: Add funding stage and the date of the last funding round to these companies.
positive.expected_behavior: States the cost first, looks the companies up in the Crunchbase database, joins the results onto the list by domain or LinkedIn URL, drops candidates that match no company, and shows the table with the new funding columns. Companies without funding data are left blank, not guessed.

positive.prompt: Export this company list as a CSV file.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a CSV export of the current company list with a download link and the number of rows exported.

negative.description: Sending messages is out of scope: the plugin drafts only
negative.prompt: Send this cold email to all 20 prospects right now.

negative.description: Guessing personal email addresses is refused
negative.prompt: Guess the personal Gmail addresses of these prospects.

negative.description: Bulk deletion in the CRM is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete every contact in my CRM.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: GTM onboarding, company and people sourcing, interactive tables and lead review, enrichment joins, buying signals, account briefs, inbound verdicts, CRM setup and enrichment for HubSpot and Pipedrive, and cold outreach drafts.
